title: Inventory Forecasting
meta: Your past sales turned into a simple stock plan showing what to reorder and when. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Inventory forecasting to plan what to reorder
overview: Running out of bestsellers and sitting on slow stock both cost money. We study your sales history, seasons and supplier lead times and build a simple forecast for each product, showing expected sales, days of stock left and a suggested reorder date and quantity. The forecast lives in a sheet you own, with clear notes on how each figure is worked out.

faq: How much sales history do I need?
At least six months helps, and twelve is better so seasons show up. With little history we say so, and show wider ranges instead of false precision.
No. It is an informed estimate based on the past, and surprises such as a viral post or supply delay can change things. We show a low and high range for each product.
Which platforms can you pull sales from?
Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, Etsy and eBay exports all work, or a plain spreadsheet. We tell you the exact report to download from your admin.
Will it connect to my live stock count?
The starter package works from exports you refresh. Live syncing with your store is possible as a custom job, which we quote separately after reviewing your setup.
